6. Code on origin/main: chief/turn.py (route_turn, run_turn, the gp-progress ticker), chief/targets.py (chat_lane, chat_session_REDACTED, his_target), chief/telegram_in.py (the listener, its key `tg:<chat>:<message_id>`, ANNOUNCED, file drops), chief/media.py (voice notes, TEXT_MAX, _SPOKEN), chief/drop.py, chief/agent.py (run(), ask_prompt, DATA_RULE, CONTRACT, the saver, record()), chief/grammar.py `_fallback`, bots/learned/skills/reader.py (_real_home, _media_words), and wherever STATUS_STILL and STATUS_STILL_BY live.

What I need back, short and concrete:

- The "floor" list: existing tests (file::test) whose asserted route or output the lane changes, found by reading what each asserts about a plain message in a bot chat. The spec says the floor is amended at load, so this list must be complete; say how you searched.
- Order of build that keeps each step testable red-first.

Keep it under 900 words. No em dashes.

You are the H3 builder for track H (Health) of the Grok Bot plan in the chief repo (github assafkip/chief). I am the track H lead; you report to me. H3 is on the critical path (B3 and J3 wait on it), so speed matters, but the gates stay.

FIRST read `~/.config/chief/gs/track-brief.md` in full. It binds you (PRD flow, review, merge, hard rules, reporting, the speed rules and the Priority section).

## The issue
- Spec: `.prd-os/issues/gs-health-receipts.md` (id `gs-health-receipts`, issue 3 of 8 of `prd-gs-health-2026-11-11`). PRD: `.prd-os/prds/prd-gs-health-2026-11-11.md` (section for H3, RCA F16). Decisions: `canonical/grokbot/decisions-gs-health.md` and the PRD's "Resolved decisions".
- 11 deliverables: one `config.write_receipt(job, payload, *, kind=post, path=None)` for every last-run receipt (post vs watch schema), every writer routed through it with an AST census, readers kept working, the lifeguard's deploy watch, `python3 -m chief.health --receipts [--json]`, refused-brief and refused-interval rules, deadman watch receipt, store-size receipt (resolves sp-36aa6da5), hands receipt (closes ASK-3143, resolves spillover `defer-gp-cu-hands-finding-20` with this issue as its resolution ref), 17 named tests each seen red first, 4 named mutants killed.

## Worktree and branch
- Create `~/projects/chief-worktrees/gs-gs-health-receipts` on branch `gs/gs-health-receipts`, cut from `origin/gs/gs-collector-receipts` (H1, PR #393, CI running now). H3 builds on H1's jobs.py. When #393 squash-merges, merge origin/main into your branch (never rebase a pushed branch; force push is blocked). I will message you H1's merge sha.
- Load now: `python3 /Users/assafkipnis/.claude/plugins/cache/kipi/kipi-dsse/0.16.0/scripts/issue_runner.py load gs-health-receipts` (id, not a path), then `approve`. Issue 3 of the PRD, plan matches the manifest, so no advisor wait. Load the `fable-discipline` skill via the Skill tool before the first edit.

## Deps (deps_ready is your first required check; only verify waits on it)
- H1 gs-collector-receipts: PR #393. H5 gs-runtime-checkout: a separate builder is building it now; it creates `scripts/chief_deploy.py` and `launchd/deploy.plist`. A1 gs-out-text: PR #387 (track A); its stored-text dirs are what store-size measures.
- Build everything that does not need H5 or A1 first: write_receipt, the census, every jobs.py / routine_runs.py / skills_md.py / computer_probe.py / base44/live_check.py writer, readers, health --receipts, deadman, refused rules, hands. Do the deploy writer and deploy watch after H5 merges, and store-size from #387's diff (follow main if it changes before merge). I will message you when H5 and #387 merge.

## Known amendments and notes (do each at load or when you reach it; spec edits by `issue_runner.py amend --reason "..."`)
- T1 (PR #386) removes the tuple `('lgtm', 'brief')` from tests/test_health.py's ran-jobs setup. Take main's line when T1 merges; do not fight it.
- health.py's docstring says mac-down "replaces every other problem", but since #373 a Mac-down day files mac-down plus podcast. Decide which is right, pin it with a test in tests/test_health.py, record the decision and its reason in the PR body.
- Reword the stale comment in chief/jobs.py's lifeguard, "Machine health (DEC-52): the one engineering signal that reaches HIM". After H2 (PR #389) machine health reaches him only on critical, and every state change is a Sana line.

- "Closes ASK-<n>" only in the PR that ships the fix: H3 ships ASK-3143's fix, so "Closes ASK-3143" is right.

- `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-assafkipnis-projects-chief/1a248af6-1a3b-4ef7-ba7e-d34e542c0d62/scratchpad/track-h/h3/test_gs_health_receipts.py` (5 schema tests), `h3/config_write_receipt.py` (ReceiptSchemaError, RECEIPT_KEYS, _receipt_strict, write_receipt via effects.atomic_write imported inside the function, since effects.py imports config), `h3/health_receipts.py` (receipt_rows, receipts_line).

## Tools
- `issue_runner.py` (load, approve, amend --reason, verify, mutant <name>, record-review <kind>, complete-review <kind> --verdict --evidence-file .prd-os/reviews/<id>-<kind>.md, triage, close) and `issue_findings.py` (add <id> --source ... --allowed-files-json, set-disposition, count --in-scope-pending), both under `/Users/assafkipnis/.claude/plugins/cache/kipi/kipi-dsse/0.16.0/scripts/`. Close refuses until every deliverable box is ticked.
- mutate.py: `python3 /Users/assafkipnis/.claude/plugins/cache/kipi/prd-os/0.32.0/scripts/mutate.py --file F --anchor A --replacement R -- <check>`. Single-line anchors only (multi-line ones fail to apply). One run at a time.
- Review recorder used for H1: `.../scratchpad/track-h/record_reviews.py <issue-id> <round1-transcript> <round2-transcript>` (writes the two evidence files, records both review kinds, adds findings). Adapt it if you only run one round.
- CI watcher with a deadline: `.../scratchpad/track-h/watch_pr.sh <pr> [seconds]`. macOS has no `timeout`.

## Review (speed rule)
- Check `~/.config/chief/gs/codex-out` first; if it exists skip Codex. Else ping: `codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -m gpt-6-astra -s read-only "Reply with the single word: ready" < /dev/null`; on a credit or usage failure write `date -u > ~/.config/chief/gs/codex-out`. Without Codex, spawn one fresh sana reviewer given only the diff.
- One review round. A second only if round 1 finds a blocker or major, and it reads only the delta. Tag each finding outcome, form or seam; fix seams red-first in code.

## Test budget and timing (measured)
- Locally run only required_checks and the owning tests; never the full suite. CI validate is the full gate.
- The lefthook pre-commit floor runs the full suite (about 9 to 15 minutes when other builders run theirs) whenever a `.prd-os` path is staged. Batch `.prd-os` changes into as few commits as you can and run commits in the background with a watcher.
- commit-msg needs an ASK id (use ASK-3143) or `[no-issue: reason]`.

## Stop rules
- Same failure twice: stop that approach and report the root cause to me. Never a third try of the same thing. Cap 3 rounds on anything.
- Waiting: never fixed sleeps; a watcher that exits on the event with a deadline. If nothing moves for 30 minutes, message me what holds and since when.

## Hard rules (verbatim, binding)
- `~/projects/chief` is the live runtime and holds the founder's uncommitted files. Never commit, stash, clean, reset, checkout or edit there. Read only.
- Never call any `mcp__claude-in-chrome__` tool.
- Never bypass the destructive-op hook. No recursive deletes. Remove a tracked file with `git rm` on that one path. Write scripts and drivers with the Write tool (long inline commands time out the hook).
- Tests never touch live data: temp dirs and fakes only. conftest pins CHIEF_CONFIG_DIR, CHIEF_TELEGRAM_DIR and CHIEF_CREDENTIAL_STORE but NOT HOME.
- You never run `com.chief.deploy`, never touch launchd, never install a plist.
- Outside contracts on `telegram_out.py` stay: `alert(text, lines=True)` and `post_to`'s call shapes and result keys `delivered`, `held`, `saved`, `link`.
- No em dashes in anything you write. Ticket text in short plain sentences. Never write "someone" or "a human".
- Before merge: merge origin/main into the branch, wait for validate green, then `gh pr merge <n> --repo assafkip/chief --squash`. Pre-authorized. Do not delete the remote branch.
- Commit messages end with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
  Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_REDACTED
- PR bodies end with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

  https://claude.ai/code/session_REDACTED

## Report back (final message to me)
PR number and merge sha, verify counts, review findings and dispositions, mutants with verdicts, the mac-down decision, anything left open with the script or agent that takes it next. If you hit a hold you cannot clear (a dep not merged after you finish everything else), tell me which dep and since when, then keep authoring.
